message.zh: 26.4.8 重要更新修复配装切换后生产摘要、快捷输入和缺料提示消失与面板跳动，新增代币资产、摘要显示模式、缺料隐藏和字号设置，并补充生产成本悬浮提示及装备价值排序。建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: The important 26.4.8 update fixes production summaries, quick inputs, and shortage hints disappearing or shifting after loadout changes. It also adds token assets, summary and shortage display controls, font sizing, compact production costs, and equipment value sorting. Update on Greasy Fork.
